# Dashboard: NEAR, three layers, one token

Every chart behind the thesis, with one plain sentence on what it shows and the query behind it. Every number is computed from the files in `data/` by `make charts`. Data as of Nov 6, 2026. The argument is in [THESIS.md](THESIS.md) and the methods in [METHODS.md](METHODS.md). For hover readouts and a data table under every chart, open `site/index.html` in a browser (no server needed).

**Sections:** [Follow the money](#follow-the-money) · [NEAR L1](#near-l1) · [NEAR Intents](#near-intents) · [NEAR AI](#near-ai) · [Revenue and the token](#revenue-and-the-token) · [Scenarios](#scenarios)

## Follow the money

What each layer earned in the latest complete month, and how much of it reached the token.

<a id="money-flow"></a>

### Follow the money: what each layer earned in Oct 2026, and what reached the token

In Oct 2026, burns and buybacks captured 538.4K NEAR, 19.5% of the NEAR issued that month, and staking for NEAR AI locked another 687.3K NEAR.

![Follow the money: what each layer earned in Oct 2026, and what reached the token](site/charts/money-flow.svg)

<sub>Latest month with complete data for all three layers. NEAR AI sales are an estimate: OpenRouter tokens at NEAR AI's list prices. Staked NEAR is locked, not removed, and can be withdrawn. Source: [revenue.near.org](https://revenue.near.org/) (fetched 2026-11-05); NEAR BigQuery public dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us) (data through 2026-11-05); [NearBlocks (NEAR price)](https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts) (fetched 2026-11-05); [OpenRouter, NEAR AI provider page](https://openrouter.ai/provider/near-ai) (fetched 2026-11-06); NEAR archival RPC (validator stake) (fetched 2026-11-05). Code: [`analysis/c1_revenue_mix.py`](../../analysis/c1_revenue_mix.py), [`analysis/c5_near_ai.py`](../../analysis/c5_near_ai.py), [`analysis/c6_capture.py`](../../analysis/c6_capture.py), [`queries/supply_flows_daily.sql`](../../queries/supply_flows_daily.sql), [`queries/l1_activity.sql`](../../queries/l1_activity.sql), [`queries/revenue_wallet_balances.sql`](../../queries/revenue_wallet_balances.sql). Supports C1, C5, C6.</sub>

<details><summary>Query behind this chart</summary>

**queries/supply_flows_daily.sql (NEAR BigQuery)**

```sql
-- Daily NEAR burned and NEAR minted since 2025-01-01, from block-to-block changes in total supply.
-- Within an epoch, total supply only falls: by the NEAR burned in each block (70% of L1 gas fees;
-- the other 30% is paid to contract developers and stays in supply). At each epoch boundary it
-- jumps up by the newly minted NEAR (validator rewards, i.e. inflation). So:
--   burned = sum of block-to-block decreases, minted = sum of increases.
-- Reads two numeric columns from the 32 GB blocks table, far cheaper than summing fees from the
-- 9.8 TB execution_outcomes table (173 GB). Differences are taken within each calendar month, so one
-- block-to-block change per month (the first block of the month) is not counted.
-- Used for: C1 (L1 side of the revenue mix: burned NEAR) and C6 (burn and issuance in the capture ratio).
WITH b AS (
  SELECT
    block_date,
    total_supply - LAG(total_supply) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC(block_date, MONTH) ORDER BY block_height) AS d
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.blocks`
  WHERE block_date >= '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT
  block_date,
  SUM(IF(d < 0, -d, 0)) / 1e24 AS burned_near,
  SUM(IF(d > 0, d, 0)) / 1e24 AS minted_near,
  COUNTIF(d > 0) AS mint_blocks
FROM b
GROUP BY block_date
ORDER BY block_date
```

**queries/l1_activity.sql (NEAR BigQuery)**

```sql
-- L1 activity since 2025-01-01, from one scan of the transactions table (two result shapes):
--   level = 'daily':    one row per day with total transactions, distinct signers (proxy for
--                       daily active accounts), transactions sent directly to intents.near,
--                       and NEAR burnt converting transactions to receipts.
--   level = 'receiver': one row per month and receiving account (top 25 per month), to see
--                       which apps drive L1 activity and which large app left in early 2026.
-- GROUPING SETS lets both come from a single pass over four columns, which roughly halves the
-- bytes scanned compared with two separate queries. Longer L1 history (2020+) comes from NearBlocks.
-- Used for: C2 and the L1 layer in Part 2.
WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT
    IF(GROUPING(block_date) = 0, 'daily', 'receiver') AS level,
    block_date,
    month,
    receiver_account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transactions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT signer_account_id) AS signers,
    COUNTIF(receiver_account_id = 'intents.near') AS tx_to_intents,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(receiver_account_id = 'intents.near', signer_account_id, NULL)) AS signers_to_intents,
    SUM(receipt_conversion_tokens_burnt) / 1e24 AS tx_conversion_burnt_near
  FROM (
    SELECT block_date, DATE_TRUNC(block_date, MONTH) AS month, receiver_account_id,
           signer_account_id, receipt_conversion_tokens_burnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions`
    WHERE block_date >= '2025-01-01'
  )
  GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((block_date), (month, receiver_account_id))
)
SELECT *
FROM grouped
WHERE TRUE
QUALIFY level = 'daily'
     OR ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level, month ORDER BY transactions DESC) <= 25
ORDER BY level, block_date, month, transactions DESC
```

**queries/revenue_wallet_balances.sql (NEAR BigQuery)**

```sql
-- Daily (per-epoch) NEAR balances of the wallets that receive NEAR Intents revenue,
-- as listed on revenue.near.org. The table is clustered by account_id, so this is cheap.
-- Used for: C6 (buybacks held vs burned) and cross-checking the revenue tracker.
SELECT
  epoch_date,
  account_id,
  liquid,
  staked,
  unstaked_not_liquid,
  reward
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.ft_balances_daily`
WHERE account_id IN (
  'buybacks.multisignature.near',
  'fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near',
  '1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near'
)
  AND epoch_date >= '2025-01-01'  -- partition filter (this table has epoch_date, not block_date)
ORDER BY account_id, epoch_date
```

**revenue.near.org**

```text
GET https://revenue.near.org/  (the page embeds its data; fetch/revenue_tracker.py extracts the monthly revenue series and the daily fees-and-volume series)
```

**OpenRouter**

```text
GET https://openrouter.ai/provider/near-ai            (tokens per model per day)
GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models/<model>/endpoints   (NEAR AI's price per token)
```

**NEAR RPC**

```text
POST https://archival-rpc.mainnet.near.org
  {"method": "query", "params": {"request_type": "call_function", "account_id": "nearai.pool.near",
   "method_name": "get_total_staked_balance", "block_id": <height>}}
```

**NearBlocks**

```text
GET https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts   (daily NEAR price)
```

</details>

## NEAR L1

The base chain: how much it is used, and how much of that use is Intents.

<a id="c2-l1-tx"></a>

### NEAR L1 transactions per day, by app (monthly average)

L1 transactions fell from 7.2M a day in Jan 2025 to 729.9K in Oct 2026, mostly because two consumer apps, KaiChing and HOT, wound down.

![NEAR L1 transactions per day, by app (monthly average)](site/charts/c2-l1-tx.svg)

<sub>KaiChing = transactions signed by *.kaiching accounts; HOT = *.tg accounts and hot.tg. Complete months only. Source: NEAR BigQuery public dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us) (data through 2026-11-05). Code: [`analysis/c2_l1_settlement.py`](../../analysis/c2_l1_settlement.py), [`queries/l1_activity.sql`](../../queries/l1_activity.sql), [`queries/l1_app_split_daily.sql`](../../queries/l1_app_split_daily.sql). Supports C2.</sub>

<details><summary>Query behind this chart</summary>

**queries/l1_activity.sql (NEAR BigQuery)**

```sql
-- L1 activity since 2025-01-01, from one scan of the transactions table (two result shapes):
--   level = 'daily':    one row per day with total transactions, distinct signers (proxy for
--                       daily active accounts), transactions sent directly to intents.near,
--                       and NEAR burnt converting transactions to receipts.
--   level = 'receiver': one row per month and receiving account (top 25 per month), to see

  FROM (
    SELECT block_date, DATE_TRUNC(block_date, MONTH) AS month, receiver_account_id,
           signer_account_id, receipt_conversion_tokens_burnt
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions`
    WHERE block_date >= '2025-01-01'
  )
  GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((block_date), (month, receiver_account_id))
```

**queries/l1_app_split_daily.sql (NEAR BigQuery)**

```sql
-- Daily L1 transactions since 2025-01-01, split by the two consumer apps that dominated L1 activity:
--   KaiChing: signer is 'kaiching' or any *.kaiching account (65% of March 2026 transactions; left in April 2026)
--   HOT:      signer is any *.tg account (HOT's Telegram game and wallet accounts)
-- Signer-based, because these apps sign their users' transactions from their own sub-accounts
-- (queries/l1_drop_mar_apr_2026.sql shows signer and receiver totals for KaiChing are identical).
-- Reads only the signer column. Intents transactions per day come from l1_activity.sql.
-- Used for: C2 (L1 activity with the largest apps removed).
SELECT
  block_date,
  COUNT(*) AS transactions,
  COUNTIF(signer_account_id = 'kaiching' OR ENDS_WITH(signer_account_id, '.kaiching')) AS kaiching_tx,
  COUNTIF(ENDS_WITH(signer_account_id, '.tg')) AS hot_tg_tx
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.transactions`
WHERE block_date >= '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY block_date
ORDER BY block_date
```

</details>

### NEAR staked with NEAR AI's validator (nearai.pool.near)

NEAR staked with NEAR AI's validator rose from 10K before staking for NEAR AI opened to 1.4M on Nov 5, 2026.

![NEAR staked with NEAR AI's validator (nearai.pool.near)](site/charts/c5-stake.svg)

Source: NEAR archival RPC (validator stake) (fetched 2026-11-05); stake.dao contract views via NEAR RPC (fetched 2026-11-05); NEAR BigQuery public dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us) (data through 2026-11-05). Code: [`analysis/c5_near_ai.py`](../../analysis/c5_near_ai.py), [`fetch/nearai.py`](../../fetch/nearai.py), [`queries/nearai_pool_stake.sql`](../../queries/nearai_pool_stake.sql), [`queries/nearai_staking_activity_daily.sql`](../../queries/nearai_staking_activity_daily.sql). Supports C5.</sub>

<details><summary>Query behind this chart</summary>

**queries/nearai_pool_stake.sql (NEAR BigQuery)**

```sql
-- Per-epoch balance of the nearai.pool.near staking pool (found among current validators via RPC).
-- Hypothesis to test: this is the pool behind NEAR AI's "Staking for Inference" (launched 2026-07-30,
-- https://near.ai/blog/staking-for-near-ai). NEAR AI's docs don't name the pool, so this is evidence,
-- not confirmation. The table is clustered by account_id, so the scan is small.
-- Used for: C5 (NEAR AI as a working third layer).
SELECT epoch_date, account_id, liquid, staked, unstaked_not_liquid
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.ft_balances_daily`
WHERE account_id = 'nearai.pool.near'
  AND epoch_date >= '2025-01-01'  -- partition filter (this table has epoch_date, not block_date)
ORDER BY epoch_date
```

**queries/nearai_staking_activity_daily.sql (NEAR BigQuery)**

```sql
-- Daily activity on stake.dao (House of Stake staking contract for NEAR AI products) since 2026-07-01:
-- function-call receipts sent to it, distinct accounts calling it, and NEAR attached to those calls
-- (deposits for locks, farm stakes and purchases). Gives a day-by-day history of NEAR AI staking
-- activity, which the contract's current-state views can't.
-- Reads four columns for ~4 months. Used for: C5 (NEAR AI staking adoption over time).
SELECT
  block_date,
  COUNTIF(action_kind = 'FUNCTION_CALL') AS function_calls,
  COUNT(DISTINCT IF(action_kind = 'FUNCTION_CALL', receipt_predecessor_account_id, NULL)) AS calling_accounts
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.receipt_actions`
WHERE block_date >= '2026-07-01'
  AND receipt_receiver_account_id = 'stake.dao'
GROUP BY block_date
ORDER BY block_date
```

**NEAR RPC**

```text
POST https://archival-rpc.mainnet.near.org
  {"method": "query", "params": {"request_type": "call_function", "account_id": "nearai.pool.near",
   "method_name": "get_total_staked_balance", "block_id": <height>}}
```

**NEAR RPC, stake.dao views**

```text
POST https://free.rpc.fastnear.com
  {"method": "query", "params": {"request_type": "call_function", "account_id": "stake.dao",
   "method_name": "get_products" | "get_locks" | "get_subscriptions", "finality": "final"}}
```

</details>

## Revenue and the token

Where NEAR's protocol revenue comes from, and how much new NEAR it offsets.

<a id="c1-revenue"></a>

### NEAR protocol revenue by source, monthly (USD)

NEAR now earns far more from its share of Intents fees than from L1 gas: $2.5M against $157K in Oct 2026.

![NEAR protocol revenue by source, monthly (USD)](site/charts/c1-revenue.svg)

<sub>L1 side: NEAR burned by gas fees, valued at the daily price. Gross L1 fees = burn ÷ 0.7 before Nov 5, 2026 (when 30% of gas went to the called contract) and = burn after, when all gas is burned. Intents side: NEAR's net revenue after partner payouts. Complete months only. Source: [revenue.near.org](https://revenue.near.org/) (fetched 2026-11-05); NEAR BigQuery public dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us) (data through 2026-11-05); [NearBlocks (NEAR price)](https://api.nearblocks.io/v1/charts) (fetched 2026-11-05). Code: [`analysis/c1_revenue_mix.py`](../../analysis/c1_revenue_mix.py), [`queries/supply_flows_daily.sql`](../../queries/supply_flows_daily.sql). Supports C1.</sub>

<details><summary>Query behind this chart</summary>

**queries/supply_flows_daily.sql (NEAR BigQuery)**

```sql
-- Daily NEAR burned and NEAR minted since 2025-01-01, from block-to-block changes in total supply.
-- Within an epoch, total supply only falls: by the NEAR burned in each block (70% of L1 gas fees;
-- the other 30% is paid to contract developers and stays in supply). At each epoch boundary it
-- jumps up by the newly minted NEAR (validator rewards, i.e. inflation). So:
--   burned = sum of block-to-block decreases, minted = sum of increases.
-- Reads two numeric columns from the 32 GB blocks table, far cheaper than summing fees from the
-- 9.8 TB execution_outcomes table (173 GB). Differences are taken within each calendar month, so one
-- block-to-block change per month (the first block of the month) is not counted.
-- Used for: C1 (L1 side of the revenue mix: burned NEAR) and C6 (burn and issuance in the capture ratio).
WITH b AS (
  SELECT
    block_date,
    total_supply - LAG(total_supply) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC(block_date, MONTH) ORDER BY block_height) AS d
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.blocks`
  WHERE block_date >= '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT
  block_date,
  SUM(IF(d < 0, -d, 0)) / 1e24 AS burned_near,
  SUM(IF(d > 0, d, 0)) / 1e24 AS minted_near,
  COUNTIF(d > 0) AS mint_blocks
FROM b
GROUP BY block_date
ORDER BY block_date
```

<a id="c1-share"></a>

### Intents share of NEAR's protocol revenue, monthly

Intents has been more than half of NEAR's protocol revenue every month since Oct 2025, and above 82% every month since Jan 2026.

<a id="timeline"></a>

### When each value-capture mechanism switched on

Issuance was halved in Oct 2025, and buybacks, staking for NEAR AI and burning all L1 gas have all switched on since.

![When each value-capture mechanism switched on](site/charts/timeline.svg)

<sub>Issuance cap and gas-burn dates come from NEAR's protocol config at past blocks. The HSP-029 start date is an assumption: vote end plus the 90-day grace period. Source: NEAR BigQuery public dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us) (data through 2026-11-05); NEAR archival RPC (protocol config history) (fetched 2026-11-06); [DefiLlama NEAR Intents methodology](https://github.com/DefiLlama/dimension-adapters/blob/master/fees/near-intents) (fetched 2026-11-05); [HSP-029 vote coverage (Crypto Briefing)](https://cryptobriefing.com/near-protocol-cuts-max-issuance-1-6-percent/); config.yaml (scenario inputs). Code: [`analysis/c6_capture.py`](../../analysis/c6_capture.py), [`analysis/scenarios.py`](../../analysis/scenarios.py), [`config.yaml`](../../config.yaml), [`fetch/protocol_history.py`](../../fetch/protocol_history.py), [`queries/supply_flows_daily.sql`](../../queries/supply_flows_daily.sql). Supports C6.</sub>

<details><summary>Query behind this chart</summary>

**queries/supply_flows_daily.sql (NEAR BigQuery)**

```sql
-- Daily NEAR burned and NEAR minted since 2025-01-01, from block-to-block changes in total supply.
-- Within an epoch, total supply only falls: by the NEAR burned in each block (70% of L1 gas fees;
-- the other 30% is paid to contract developers and stays in supply). At each epoch boundary it
-- jumps up by the newly minted NEAR (validator rewards, i.e. inflation). So:
--   burned = sum of block-to-block decreases, minted = sum of increases.
-- Reads two numeric columns from the 32 GB blocks table, far cheaper than summing fees from the
-- 9.8 TB execution_outcomes table (173 GB). Differences are taken within each calendar month, so one
-- block-to-block change per month (the first block of the month) is not counted.
-- Used for: C1 (L1 side of the revenue mix: burned NEAR) and C6 (burn and issuance in the capture ratio).
WITH b AS (
  SELECT
    block_date,
    total_supply - LAG(total_supply) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC(block_date, MONTH) ORDER BY block_height) AS d
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.blocks`
  WHERE block_date >= '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT
  block_date,
  SUM(IF(d < 0, -d, 0)) / 1e24 AS burned_near,
  SUM(IF(d > 0, d, 0)) / 1e24 AS minted_near,
  COUNTIF(d > 0) AS mint_blocks
FROM b
GROUP BY block_date
ORDER BY block_date
```

**NEAR archival RPC**

```text
POST https://archival-rpc.mainnet.near.org
  {"method": "EXPERIMENTAL_protocol_config", "params": {"block_id": <first block of the day>}}
  (bisected by day to date each change in max_inflation_rate and burnt_gas_reward)
```

**config.yaml**

```text
Scenario inputs: issuance paths, growth window, half-life (no request)
```

</details>

<a id="c6-flows"></a>

### NEAR issued vs NEAR captured, monthly

NEAR captured by burns and buybacks rose to 538.4K in Oct 2026 while NEAR issued halved to about 2.7M a month, but issuance is still the larger number.

![NEAR issued vs NEAR captured, monthly](site/charts/c6-flows.svg)

<sub>Issued and burned come from block-to-block changes in total supply. New AI stake is the month's net change in NEAR staked with nearai.pool.near: locked, not removed, and withdrawable. Source: NEAR BigQuery public dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us) (data through 2026-11-05); [revenue.near.org](https://revenue.near.org/) (fetched 2026-11-05); NEAR archival RPC (validator stake) (fetched 2026-11-05). Code: [`analysis/c6_capture.py`](../../analysis/c6_capture.py), [`queries/supply_flows_daily.sql`](../../queries/supply_flows_daily.sql). Supports C6.</sub>

<a id="c6-wallets"></a>

### Where captured NEAR sits: revenue-wallet balances, month end

Most NEAR captured as Intents revenue is still held in NEAR's revenue wallets (4.1M of 4.9M NEAR at the end of Oct 2026), not burned.

![Where captured NEAR sits: revenue-wallet balances, month end](site/charts/c6-wallets.svg)

<sub>Source: NEAR BigQuery public dataset (bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us) (data through 2026-11-05); [revenue.near.org](https://revenue.near.org/) (fetched 2026-11-05). Code: [`analysis/c6_capture.py`](../../analysis/c6_capture.py), [`queries/revenue_wallet_balances.sql`](../../queries/revenue_wallet_balances.sql). Supports C6.</sub>

<details><summary>Query behind this chart</summary>

**queries/revenue_wallet_balances.sql (NEAR BigQuery)**

```sql
-- Daily (per-epoch) NEAR balances of the wallets that receive NEAR Intents revenue,
-- as listed on revenue.near.org. The table is clustered by account_id, so this is cheap.
-- Used for: C6 (buybacks held vs burned) and cross-checking the revenue tracker.
SELECT
  epoch_date,
  account_id,
  liquid,
  staked,
  unstaked_not_liquid,
  reward
FROM `bigquery-public-data.crypto_near_mainnet_us.ft_balances_daily`
WHERE account_id IN (
  'buybacks.multisignature.near',
  'fefundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near',
  '1csfundsadmin.sputnik-dao.near'
)
  AND epoch_date >= '2025-01-01'  -- partition filter (this table has epoch_date, not block_date)
ORDER BY account_id, epoch_date
```

**revenue.near.org**

```text
GET https://revenue.near.org/  (the page embeds its data; fetch/revenue_tracker.py extracts the monthly revenue series and the daily fees-and-volume series)
```

</details>

## Scenarios

Projections from the trend so far, not findings.

<a id="scenarios"></a>

### Scenarios: capture ratio, projected monthly

If Intents revenue growth halves every 2 years, burns and buybacks offset all new NEAR by Jan 2029 with HSP-029; if growth holds, by Aug 2028; with no growth, not within 6 years.

![Scenarios: capture ratio, projected monthly](site/charts/scenarios.svg)

<sub>Projections, not findings. Starting point: 2026 Q3's Intents revenue and L1 burn (a capture ratio of 19.4% in Oct 2026). Growth is in NEAR terms, so a rising NEAR price slows it. L1 burn is held at 2026 Q3's level, scaled to 100% burned from Nov 5, 2026. Lines leave the chart above 200%. Source: config.yaml (scenario inputs). Code: [`analysis/scenarios.py`](../../analysis/scenarios.py), [`config.yaml`](../../config.yaml). Supports C6.</sub>
